# Curl Coach

> > iOS apps for curling coaches and teams: game charting, strategy planning, statistics tracking, and pace of play timing.

Curl Coach provides professional-grade tools for curling coaches at all levels, from recreational to elite teams like the Canadian National Senior's Team. The flagship Curl Coach 2 app enables detailed game analysis and charting on iPad and iPhone, while Curl Clocks helps manage competition timing.

## Core Applications

- [Curl Coach](https://curlcoach.com/Curl_Coach): Curl Coach 2 iOS app for charting games and coaching teams at all levels
- [Curl Clocks](https://curlcoach.com/Curl_Coach/curlclocks.html): Curl Clocks iOS app for tracking pace of play and competition timing
